name: Russian
notes: Ten courses: two foundation, four core, four electives.
CLTR 200 and CLTR 389 may be replaced by approved equivalent courses.
Two of the core courses are content courses in literature, culture, or film - modeled as 200-level RUSS courses.

requirementGroups.sourceQuote: FOUNDATION COURSES (fulfills upper level writing): CLTR 200: Topics in Critical Thinking; CLTR 389: MLC Research Seminar

requirementGroups.label: Advanced readings
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Core Courses: RUSS 202 Advanced Readings in Russian I

requirementGroups.label: Advanced Russian II or through film
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: RUSS 205 Advanced Readings in Russian II or RUSS 209 Advanced Russian through Film

requirementGroups.label: Content courses in literature, culture, or film (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two content courses in literature, culture, or film

requirementGroups.label: Russian electives (4)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Elective Courses: Four or more courses in literature, culture, film or language beyond RUSS 102.
